newsitem.title: USA: Global Spill names CEO and CFO.
newsitem.headline: Global Spill names CEO and CFO.

text.p: Global Spill Management Inc said on Wednesday it named Karl Schwab chief executive and president, and George Weast chief financial officer.
The company also said that, with current contracts and several targeted acquisitions, revenues are likely to exceed $25 million in the 1997 fiscal year.
Schwab, who replaces Thomas Lewis, Sr. as chief executive and Stuart Berri as president, is the founder of Phoenix Wrecking Inc, which has been merged with Global Spill.
Weast replaces Robert Moskovitz. A company spokeswoman said that Lewis, Berri and Moskovitz resigned.
Global Spill added that it is changing its name to Indigo Industries Inc.
